ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, dark UI frames, icon strokes — the deepest near-black with a barely-perceptible cool cast that keeps it from feeling warm or brown against the beige canvas

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces, nav background, image bleeds — the brightest surface level that lifts content off the warm canvas

canvas-beige.$description: Canvas Beige — Page background, section bands — a warm light gray-beige that gives the whole site its sunlit, paper-like quality

steel-gray.$description: Steel Gray — Secondary body text, muted borders — the only truly achromatic neutral in the system, used sparingly to signal de-emphasis

footer-ink.$description: Footer Ink — Footer background — a pure near-black that reads as the deepest possible dark without losing detail

sand-border.$description: Sand Border — Default hairline borders, icon outlines, structural dividers — the warm tan that replaces cold gray chrome throughout the interface

warm-linen.$description: Warm Linen — Outlined action borders, link underlines, interactive link states — the lighter, more luminous sand tone that signals interactivity without filling the shape

lausanne-400.$description: Lausanne-400 — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

lausanne.$description: Primary typeface for everything from 14px body to 250px display. The 250px hero display with -0.046em tracking is the signature element — letters nearly collide, creating a monolithic word-as-architecture presence. The single weight 400 across the full scale (from 14px to 250px) means hierarchy comes from size and tracking alone, not from bold.

times.$description: System serif fallback used in tertiary body contexts. Acts as a quiet typographic counterpoint to the neo-grotesque — never set in display sizes, always at 16px with generous leading.
